::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 30th [1870]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Caroline Fairclough/24
:::

My dear [Arthur](people/person_238.qmd)
Authorities for the wars of the Roses are very scarce and bad.  I believe [Sharon Turner](other_books/otherbook_172.qmd) [^1] is the modern who has done them up best, and his notes guide to the places where he gets his authorities. I believe the best, next to the [Paston letters](other_books/otherbook_791.qmd) are Polydore Vergil, and a certain Abbot /(I think)\\ Welthamstead of St Albans who was a great Lancastrian till Queen Margaret let her wild Borderers plunder his Abbey.[^2] I believe that there are lots of documents scattered about, original letters &c.  Shakespeare went by [Hall](other_books/otherbook_793.qmd) and [Hollingshed](other_books/otherbook_792.qmd) and [Fabyan’s Chronicle](other_books/otherbook_458.qmd) which are none of them precisely history, but [Lingard](other_books/otherbook_794.qmd) and Turner tell one what is borne out. Did you ever meet with [Philippe de Commines](other_books/otherbook_795.qmd) he is deliciously quaint and his mediaeval French would delight you.

[Polly](cmy_books/cmybook_348.qmd) has been regularly squeezed out of two or three numbers of the [M Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) -  when there are rampant contributors wanting to get in, I have to sacrifice her.  She was actually in this month, and then came a London school that had to beg now or never.

Your bit of Gothic is not beyond my powers when I have not - as at this moment [Helen](people/person_1613.qmd) painting and asking me questions every minute but I will not keep the letter waiting for greater discretion

I hope Polly will continue in another month, it is written, but it is waiting for room.  I hope to be at Wantage for a day or two at the end of May.

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: CMY presumably refers to John Whethamstede  (c.1392–1465), Abbot of St. Albans.
